symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires in the network, which is also the number of roles among which the rows are distributed.
symbols.quote: Let $W$ be the number of wires in the network, which is also the number of roles among which the rows of the array are distributed.

symbols.name: call parameter
symbols.meaning: The parameter of a call, counting the selected axes of a numerical layer or the digits of an address field.
symbols.quote: The parameter $\ell$ counts the selected axes of a [numerical layer](numerical-layer.md), or the digits of an address field for interchange.

symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls that one call makes.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the total number of smaller calls that one call makes; here $s$ changes the meaning it had on earlier pages.

symbols.name: source dimension sum
symbols.meaning: The sum of the dimensions of the source labels.
symbols.quote: Let $\mu$ be the sum of the dimensions of the source labels, and let $L$ be the total dimension lost along decreasing edges, those whose head label is smaller than their tail.

symbols.name: lost dimension
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost along decreasing edges, where the head label is smaller than the tail label.
symbols.quote: Let $\mu$ be the sum of the dimensions of the source labels, and let $L$ be the total dimension lost along decreasing edges, those whose head label is smaller than their tail.

symbols.name: cost per volume
symbols.meaning: The cost of a call at parameter $\ell$ divided by its volume.
symbols.quote: Let $\gamma(\ell)$ be the cost of a call at parameter $\ell$ divided by its volume.

relations.quote: Rank-saving recursion counts its smaller calls on the wires of the [subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md).
Each call splits into smaller calls to the [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md), each on one role stream of $V/W$ bits.
The parameter $\ell$ counts the selected axes of a [numerical layer](numerical-layer.md), or the digits of an address field for interchange.
